intro: Cenarion Hold is the fortified stronghold of the Cenarion Circle situated in the harsh desert of Silithus. Established to keep watch over ancient dangers buried beneath the sands, it stands as one of the largest druidic settlements on Kalimdor and a rare safe haven in an unforgiving wasteland.

p: Perched among the desolate sands of Silithus, Cenarion Hold serves as the southern command hub for the Cenarion Circle. Reached by winding past Un'Goro Crater, the fortress was raised to monitor the dormant threats sealed beneath the desert after the historic War of the Shifting Sands. In an inhospitable expanse teeming with insectoid silithid and arid storms, the stronghold provides vital shelter, trade, and logistical support for night elf and tauren druids alike who stand sentinel over the imprisoned horrors of the past.

Because the duty of safeguarding the world from ancient evils transcends mortal squabbles, Cenarion Hold operates under strict Cenarion Circle neutrality. Both Alliance and Horde travelers are admitted inside its walls, welcomed by local quartermasters and wardens whose supply lines remain precarious. With flight routes connecting it back to outposts in Feralas, Tanaris, and Un'Goro Crater, the hold acts as the lone staging ground for mortal adventurers brave enough to investigate the rising unrest in the desert.
